description: Iowa motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Iowa?
questions.explanation: Iowa helmet law: no statewide helmet requirement.

provenance.manual: Iowa Code §321.275 Motorcycles and motorized bicycles

questions.q: What does Iowa law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Iowa: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: Iowa Code §321.275 Motorcycles and motorized bicycles

questions.q: What does Iowa require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Iowa: eye protection is not required by state law.

provenance.manual: Iowa Code §321.275 Motorcycles and motorized bicycles

questions.q: In Iowa, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Iowa issues a motorcycle permit at 14 years at the earliest.

provenance.manual: Iowa Code §321.180B Graduated driver’s licenses for persons aged fourteen through seventeen
